_comment: Pins our product ids to JamWest's Rezdy product codes so instant booking never guesses. Key = venue/product, or venue/product|Choice A|Choice B (choices sorted A to Z). Fill in from the agent account once REZDY_API_KEY is in Netlify: GET /.netlify/functions/exp-products lists the codes. Until a code is pinned the function matches by name and falls back to WhatsApp when unsure.
